title: Italics
tagline: Italics: Sell a PDF on your Website. We're building an ERC-1155 ecosystem for self-publishing.
description: Italics is a protocol for publishing digital assets like PDFs.  Italics enables readers to instantly purchase access to the PDF using MetaMask.  Publishing requires little more than a static web server because the difficult part is handled by the blockchain.  Publishers mint semi-fungible tokens that they give or sell to readers.  When a reader has the token in their wallet, Italics will unlock the PDF.
how_its_made: Italics consists of an ERC-1155 token contract that is used to represent access tokens for a PDF.  A separate Broker contract supports selling tokens to readers in exchange for a configurable price.  A Python Flask server is used to authenticate wallets by verifying a signed nonce.  The server also performs access control so that the PDF is only revealed when the authenticated wallet contains the correct ERC-1155 token.
